reviewed_behavior: A Windows-only helper opens the already-owned temporary directory with read/write and FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS; other platforms retain File::open. Both ledger and witness receive actual handles; production sync_directory_handle still requires metadata.is_dir and propagates sync_all failure.

findings.finding: The fixture now follows the existing ledger test directory-opening contract. No durability bypass, synthetic success, AccessDenied suppression, new authorization, or production synchronization change is introduced.

primary_sources.claim: Opening an existing directory handle through CreateFile requires FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS.
FlushFileBuffers requires GENERIC_WRITE on the supplied handle.

limits: These are necessary API conditions, not a guarantee of directory durability on every Windows filesystem or privilege configuration.
The new exact hosted Windows run remains required; no old green result was substituted.
